chembl/activity: Extract biological activity records from ChEMBL API
chembl/assay: Extract bioassay definitions from ChEMBL API
chembl/assay_parameters: Extract experimental assay parameters from ChEMBL API
chembl/cell_line: Extract cell lines from ChEMBL API
chembl/compound_record: Extract compound records from ChEMBL API
chembl/protein_class: ChEMBL Protein Classification hierarchy (enzyme classes, receptor types, etc.)
chembl/publication: Extract scientific publications from ChEMBL API
chembl/publication_similarity: Extract publication similarity data (Tanimoto coefficients) from ChEMBL API
chembl/publication_term: Extract publication terms (MeSH, keywords) from ChEMBL Publication records
chembl/target: Extract biological targets from ChEMBL API
crossref/publication: Enrich publication records with CrossRef metadata via DOI resolution
openalex/publication: Batch DOI resolution via OpenAlex with title fallback
pubmed/publication: Extract publication metadata from PubMed via Entrez API
semanticscholar/publication: Batch DOI resolution via Semantic Scholar with title fallback
uniprot/idmapping: Maps ChEMBL target IDs to UniProt accessions via UniProt ID Mapping API
